info.brief: Factory of random number generator instances (non-global) for specific algorithms. Supports pcg32
info.description: Factory of random number generator instances (non-global) for specific algorithms. Supports pcg32

elements.name: rnd.pcg32
elements.description: Creates a pcg32 instance. Can specify init_state and init_seq to start with a seed, or nothing to get a random one

parameters.name: init_state
parameters.doc: init_state is the starting state for the PCG32, you can pass any 64-bit value.

parameters.name: init_seq
parameters.doc: init_seq selects the output sequence for the PCG32, you can pass any 64-bit value, although only the low 63 bits are significant.
